about:
Creative Werks Inc. was founded in 2003 by the Folkestad family in Des Moines, Iowa. The family-owned business began as an electronic engineering firm focused on RF and embedded controls for off-highway and utility vehicles, and has since expanded into a full-service design, engineering, and manufacturing operation.

The company designs, engineers, and produces a wide variety of electronic control systems entirely in-house at its Des Moines facility. Its capabilities span RF control systems, custom embedded electronics, electromechanical engineering, and wireless RF solutions. A full machine shop supports production with 5-axis and 3-axis CNC mills, dual-spindle lathes with bar feeders, and dual SMT pick-and-place machines for circuit board assembly. Creative Werks reports an annual output of roughly 65,000 systems, with capacity to double that volume. It also stocks off-the-shelf controllers — 4, 6, and 75-channel remotes, linear actuators, and basic control units — ready for immediate shipment.

Creative Werks serves off-highway, agricultural, industrial, mobile, and automotive markets, as well as prototyping and custom projects. Notable public projects include the Foxzilla vehicle build, the Josh Robinson tool cart, the Spool Rule, and wiring for Jeff Lutz’s 57-foot dragster. Customers range from OEMs needing custom embedded controls to aftermarket performance shops seeking PWM fan controllers and RF remote systems.

The company emphasizes total control over design, engineering, and production as its differentiator, maintaining quality through every step. Its combination of an engineering team and a fully equipped machine shop allows it to develop solutions that would otherwise require multiple vendors.
